CustomField.description: Title of the PDF report, and its file name, when the report is run from a Complaint or Product History Review. Blank = this setting record's Label (or Product History Report when the record is called Default).
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Report title when run from a Complaint or PHR. Also the file name. Blank = this record's Label, for example Complaint Summary Report.
CustomField.label: PHR Report Title
